sources.finding: East US 2 and Sweden Central support Foundry projects; feature-specific and live capacity checks remain required.
Both candidates list Responses, Agents, private VNet and Function support; gpt-4.1-mini lists Functions support.
Global Standard tables list gpt-4.1-mini version 2025-04-14 in eastus2 and swedencentral; global processing is not region bound.

Private Standard requires BYO Storage/Cosmos/Search, private endpoints and dedicated Microsoft.App/environments subnet. Capability-settings API 2026-07-15-preview differs from legacy sample capability-host provisioning.
Standard dependencies and separate caller/runtime roles documented; Cosmos minimum/account/container statements require API-path-specific sizing.
New project endpoint, C# DeclarativeAgentDefinition, CreateAgentVersion and Responses interaction; not classic Projects 1.x.
Client executes function calls and returns tool outputs; .NET and private Standard supported; example uses gpt-4.1-mini.
Foundry Agent Consumer for invocation-only application; Foundry User for separate installer. Agents in a project are not independent business-unit data-isolation boundaries.
Standard v2 public gateway can reach private backends; dedicated /24 recommended subnet delegated to Microsoft.Web/serverFarms with NSG.
Internal environment has no public endpoint; app external ingress in an internal environment means VNet-visible, not internet-visible.
Private endpoints require Premium; private image push requires network line of sight and private DNS, not a public hosted build agent.
RSA 2K/3K/4K keys support PS256 signing of SHA-256 digests; signatures demonstrate integrity, not factual correctness.
Current Foundry account/project IaC and documented private Standard sample; caller provisioning roles differ from runtime roles.
AVM supports AIServices S0, network injection and private endpoints; recheck released module interface/version before Bicep.
AVM service module exists; default Premium is not the proposed StandardV2 override.
